details: 48 finite birth-death moment systems solved over exact rational numbers and compared with the renewal formula
144 direct rational transition-power return probabilities checked
Numerical sign brackets and representative values tested; global root uniqueness is proved analytically
unproved_by_checker: Finite tests do not certify the all-m or all-c theorem, asymptotic limit, or uniqueness of stationary points; these follow from the accompanying proof.
